modelOverview: Introduced in 2017, the ref. 5320 is Patek Philippe's vintage-inspired perpetual calendar, drawing on the layout of historic references 1526 and 2497 with a sector-style dial, in-line day/month apertures at 12 o'clock and a combined date/moon phase/day-night/leap-year display at 6 o'clock. Housed in a 40mm white gold case, it is powered by the self-winding Calibre 324 S Q. The 5320G-011, unveiled at Watches & Wonders 2022, replaced the original cream-dial version with a rose-gilt (salmon) opaline dial.

5320G-011.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 324 S Q · 368 parts, 29 jewels · 28,800 vph (4Hz) · min. 35h / max. 45h power reserve
5320G-011.materials: 18k white gold case on a chocolate brown alligator leather strap with a white gold fold-over clasp
5320G-011.bezel: Fixed 18k white gold bezel with stepped, vintage-style lugs
5320G-011.dial: Rose-gilt opaline (salmon) dial with charcoal-grey syringe-shaped hands and applied luminous white gold numerals; in-line day/month apertures at 12 o'clock and a combined date/moon phase/day-night/leap-year display at 6 o'clock
5320G-011.description: The 5320G-011 is the salmon-dial evolution of Patek Philippe's vintage-inspired Perpetual Calendar, introduced at Watches & Wonders 2022 to replace the original cream-dial 5320G-001. Its 40mm white gold case and sector-style dial recall historic references 1526 and 2497, while the self-winding Calibre 324 S Q drives a full perpetual calendar with moon phase accurate to within one day every 122 years. Every piece we offer is professionally sourced and authenticated.

variants.White Gold: The 5320G-011 in 18k white gold with its rose-gilt (salmon) opaline dial, charcoal-grey syringe hands and chocolate brown alligator strap - the defining white gold/salmon dial combination introduced in 2022.
